raw_result.summary: Retained high architect corrected the Story 18.3 plan for in-place dedicated managed workspace. Declared only contained .codegraph tool-state writes; source/config/hooks remain read-only to confined children. October CLI init then native MCP is selected, with no daemon/watch, telemetry/update-off and OS network denial; optional CLI project-config/hook writes and total startup footprint remain owned-fixture qualification gates. One index owner serializes preparation and shares a validated index across same-binding Worker sessions for workspace/batch lifetime; cleanup is owner disposition, never per Worker. Story 18.2 purpose-bound write-capable lease and Story 18.1 generated-state exclusion remain owner-held dependencies; no copy or competing contract. Windows child identity/ACL availability and Vulgata app-bound native qualification remain unproved. Deterministic implementation-design validation and git diff --check passed.
